definition: to look at written words and understand them
description: A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.

de.answer: Sie liest an der Straße ein Buch.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está leyendo un libro junto a la carretera.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?
